# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform offering business advertising solutions through TikTok for Business, including Ads Manager, Creator Marketplace, and TikTok Shop.

TikTok for Business provides brands with advertising tools such as Branded Hashtag Challenges, In-Feed Ads, TopView, and Branded Effects to reach Gen Z and millennial audiences. The platform offers integration with Shopify, App Event Optimization, and API access through Business Center and Creative Exchange.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- Ads Manager
- Creator Marketplace
- Branded Hashtag Challenge
- In-Feed Ads
- TopView
- Branded Effects
- TikTok Shop
- Business Center
- Creative Center
- App Event Optimization
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Influencer marketing
- Gen Z marketing
- E-commerce integration

## Brand Advertising Success Stories

- [Maybelline | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/maybelline-323): Maybelline SuperStay campaign in Vietnam using hashtag challenge & effects
- [BOSS | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/boss-319): BOSS fashion brand uses Branded Hashtag Challenge for Gen Z campaign
- [BMW UK | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bmw-uk-275): BMW UK launches 1 Series with TopView and In-Feed Ads for youth audience
- [Benefit® | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/benefit%C2%AE-318): Benefit cosmetics uses auction strategy to promote new brow product
- [Lipton Ice Tea Romania | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/lipton-ice-tea-romania-286): Lipton Ice Tea Romania drives awareness for summer flavors campaign
- [Indomilk | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/indomilk-303): Indomilk launches Tobot co-branded milk in Indonesia with Branded Effect

## E-commerce & App Growth Case Studies

- [ABI Game Studio | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/abi-game-studio-322): ABI Game Studio boosts mobile game installs using Pangle placement
